---
title: "Smoke test: pandas in the browser"
engine: markdown
description: "Not a unit. Checks pandas, matplotlib and the cp1252 customer file in Pyodide."
resources:
  - ../data/quotes.csv
  - ../data/customers.csv
---

Technical check, not course content: the cells run on page load and the last one prints a summary line.

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| caption: Load
import pandas as pd
quotes = pd.read_csv("data/quotes.csv", sep=";", decimal=",")
customers = pd.read_csv("data/customers.csv", sep=";", encoding="cp1252")
print(quotes.head())
print(customers.head())
print([n for n in customers["customer_name"] if not n.isascii()][:3])
```

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| caption: Groupby and merge
quotes["value"] = quotes["quantity"] * quotes["unit_price_eur"]
by_region = quotes.groupby("region")["value"].sum()
merged = quotes.merge(customers, on="customer_id")
print(by_region.round(0))
print(merged.groupby("segment")["value"].sum().round(0))
```

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| caption: Chart
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
by_region.plot.bar()
plt.xlabel("Region")
plt.ylabel("Quote value (EUR)")
plt.title("Quote value by region")
plt.show()
```

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| caption: Summary
ok = "Chemiewerk Süd AG" in set(customers["customer_name"])
print(f"SMOKE pandas rows={len(quotes)} customers={len(customers)} cp1252_ok={ok} merge_rows={len(merged)}")
```
